whyItIsWrong: A pasted abstract with figures and a conclusion, to be summarised. What a document says stays in the knowledge base and the report. The extractor wrote the abstract's comparison, population and outcome as inferred project facts in 3 of 3 samples, turning a paper the researcher was reading into a statement about their project.

messages.text: 这是一篇论文摘要，帮我总结：“在 3200 例房颤患者中，利伐沙班组大出血发生率为 2.1%，华法林组为 3.4%，校正 HR 0.72（95%CI 0.58–0.89），结论认为利伐沙班在真实世界中出血风险更低。”
摘要报告利伐沙班组大出血率更低（2.1% 对 3.4%），校正 HR 0.72，结论支持其出血风险更低，但它是观察性研究，混杂仍需考虑。
